origin=pd.Timestamp('2024-01-01')
as_of=pd.Timestamp('2025-07-01')
history=s[s.date<as_of].copy()
categories={c:sorted(history[c].unique()) for c in ['shop_id','format']}
weather=history.assign(month=history.date.dt.month).groupby('month')[['temp','rain']].mean()
def prep(s,as_of='2025-07-01'):
 a=s.copy(); cutoff=pd.Timestamp(as_of)
 hist=history[history.date<cutoff]
 climate=hist.assign(month=hist.date.dt.month).groupby('month')[['temp','rain']].mean()
 a['weekday']=a.date.dt.weekday; a['month']=a.date.dt.month
 a['weekend']=(a.weekday>=5).astype(int); a['day_n']=(a.date-origin).dt.days
 future=a.date>=cutoff
 for c in ['temp','rain']:
  a[c]=a[c].astype(float)
  a.loc[future,c]=a.loc[future,'month'].map(climate[c])
 for c in categories: a[c]=pd.Categorical(a[c],categories=categories[c])
 return pd.get_dummies(a[['temp','rain','holiday','promo','weekday','month','weekend','day_n','shop_id','format']],columns=['shop_id','format'],dtype=int)
X=prep(s); tr=s.date<as_of
n_train=int(tr.sum()); n_test=int((~tr).sum())
